User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can load a recommendation feed from the backend
Acceptance Criteria: The Android client renders a successful PostgreSQL-backed feed response

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can distinguish text, image, video, and official-top cards
Acceptance Criteria: Each supported content type is mapped to its dedicated card presentation

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can pull to refresh without duplicated stories
Acceptance Criteria: Only newer records are requested and duplicate IDs are removed

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can load older stories with cursor pagination
Acceptance Criteria: Reaching the list end requests the next cursor and preserves current cards

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can see cached feed content when the backend is unavailable
Acceptance Criteria: Initial loading uses scene-filtered Room data before or after a failed network refresh

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can browse independent content channels
Acceptance Criteria: Recommend Following Hot Shenzhen Video Featured Image War Sports Finance and Technology return channel-specific content

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can open a story and view its complete content
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting a card navigates by news ID to a detail API-backed screen

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I can start video content and leave the screen safely
Acceptance Criteria: Video playback prepares starts pauses and releases with screen lifecycle

User Story or Use Case: As a maintainer, I can run the backend and PostgreSQL using Docker Compose
Acceptance Criteria: The stack starts and the health endpoint returns ok

User Story or Use Case: As a maintainer, I can verify core behavior with automated tests
Acceptance Criteria: Android backend integration and stress-test scripts complete successfully

User Story or Use Case: As a maintainer, I can run CI and security checks for the final commit
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub Actions completes CI CodeQL Trivy and ZAP jobs and publishes artifacts
Repository Evidence: Historical Android CI succeeded at 0d5bcd4; remaining workflows are local and require final push

User Story or Use Case: As a reader, I receive ranking reasons that explain surfaced content
Acceptance Criteria: The feed response and UI expose deterministic recommendation reasons

User Story or Use Case: As a future user, I can sign in search and interact socially
Acceptance Criteria: Authentication search likes comments and account synchronization are implemented and tested
